Each growth step is one\n//    block-wide min-reduction over (diameter, index), which reproduces the\n//    \"smallest max-distance, lowest index on ties\" selection of the original.\n//\n//  * The number of unclustered neighbours within the threshold is an exact\n//    upper bound on the cardinality a seed can reach.             GpuContext& gpu, const int rank, const int nranks) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> bounds(N);\n These evaluations are independent, so the seeds are split\n//    across MPI ranks (one GPU per rank) and, inside a rank, across CUDA\n//    thread blocks: one block grows one candidate cluster at a time.\n//\n//  * A candidate cluster grown from seed s can only ever contain points whose\n//    distance to s is below the threshold. Each block therefore first compacts\n//    those points into a per-block candidate list and then grows the cluster\n//    incrementally, keeping for every candidate the maximum distance to the\n//    current members (the \"diameter if added\"). Each growth step is one\n//    block-wide min-reduction over (diameter, index), which reproduces the\n//    \"smallest max-distance, lowest index on ties\" selection of the original.\n//\n//  * The number of unclustered neighbours within the threshold is an exact\n//    upper bound on the cardinality a seed can reach. Seeds are processed in\n//    decreasing-bound order, and a seed whose bound is below the best\n//    cardinality already found is skipped. Skipped seeds can never be the\n//    winner (max cardinality, lowest seed index on ties), so the result is\n//    unchanged. The bounds are maintained exactly on the GPU.\n//\n//  * The winning seed is chosen with one MPI_Allreduce. Result valid in all threads.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void blockMin(double& v, int& idx, int& slot,\n                                         double* s_v, int* s_i, int* s_s) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    warpMin(v, idx, slot);\n    if (lane == 0) { s_v[warp] = v; s_i[warp] = idx; s_s[warp] = slot; }\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (warp == 0) {\n        v = (lane < QT_WARPS) ? s_v[lane] : INFINITY;\n        idx = (lane < QT_WARPS) ? s_i[lane] : INT_MAX;\n        slot = (lane < QT_WARPS) ? s_s[lane] : -1;\n        warpMin(v, idx, slot);\n        if (lane == 0) { s_v[0] = v; s_i[0] = idx; s_s[0] = slot; }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    v = s_v[0]; idx = s_i[0]; slot = s_s[0];\n    __syncthreads();\n}\n\n// Initial exact upper bound for every point: number of points (including\n// itself) within the threshold distance.\n__global__ void initBoundsKernel(const Point* __restrict__ pts, const int N,\n                                 const double thr, int* __restrict__ bounds) {\n    const int p = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (p >= N) return;\n    const Point me = pts[p];\n    int cnt = 0;\n    for (int q = 0; q < N; ++q) {\n        if (distance(me, pts[q]) < thr) cnt++;\n    }\n    bounds[p] = cnt;\n}\n\n// Subtract the newly clustered members from the bounds of unclustered points.\n__global__ void updateBoundsKernel(const Point* __restrict__ pts, const int N,\n                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                   const int* __restrict__ members, const int m,\n                                   const double thr, int* __restrict__ bounds) {\n    const int p = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (p >= N || clustered[p]) return;\n    const Point me = pts[p];\n    int cnt = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {\n        if (distance(me, pts[members[i]]) < thr) cnt++;\n    }\n    bounds[p] -= cnt;\n}\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block; blocks pull seeds dynamically\n// from a sorted work list. Writes the cardinality of every seed (0 if pruned).\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(QT_BLOCK)\nseedCardinalityKernel(const Point* __restrict__ pts, const int N,\n                      const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                      const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int nseeds,\n                      const int* __restrict__ bounds, const double thr,\n                      int* __restrict__ g_idx, double* __restrict__ g_md,\n                      const int scratch_stride,\n                      int* __restrict__ out_card,\n                      int* __restrict__ work_counter,\n                      int* __restrict__ best_hint) {\n    __shared__ double s_rv[QT_WARPS];\n    __shared__ int s_ri[QT_WARPS];\n    __shared__ int s_rs[QT_WARPS];\n    __shared__ int s_pos;\n    __shared__ int s_count;\n    __shared__ int s_idx[QT_SHARED_CAP];\n    __shared__ double s_md[QT_SHARED_CAP];\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int lane = tid & 31;\n    const unsigned lanemask_lt = (1u << lane) - 1u;\n\n    int* const blk_idx = g_idx + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * scratch_stride;\n    double* const blk_md = g_md + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * scratch_stride;\n\n    while (true) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            s_pos = atomicAdd(work_counter, 1);\n            s_count = 0;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int pos = s_pos;\n        if (pos >= nseeds) break;\n        const int seed = seeds[pos];\n        const Point sp = pts[seed];\n\n        // Prune: this seed cannot beat the best cardinality found so far.\n        if (bounds[seed] < *reinterpret_cast<volatile int*>(best_hint)) {\n            if (tid == 0) out_card[pos] = 0;\n            __syncthreads();\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Phase 1: compact unclustered points within the threshold of the seed\n        // (warp-aggregated atomics on the shared counter).\n        for (int base = 0; base < N; base += QT_BLOCK) {\n            const int c = base + tid;\n            double d = 0.0;\n            bool ok = false;\n            if (c < N && c != seed && !clustered[c]) {\n                d = distance(pts[c], sp);\n                ok = d < thr;\n            }\n            const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, ok);\n            if (mask) {\n                const int leader = __ffs(mask) - 1;\n                int slotbase = 0;\n                if (lane == leader) slotbase = atomicAdd(&s_count, __popc(mask));\n                slotbase = __shfl_sync(0xffffffffu, slotbase, leader);\n                if (ok) {\n                    const int slot = slotbase + __popc(mask & lanemask_lt);\n                    blk_idx[slot] = c;\n                    blk_md[slot] = d;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int n = s_count;\n\n        // Exact bound check after compaction.\n        if (n + 1 < *reinterpret_cast<volatile int*>(best_hint)) {\n            if (tid == 0) out_card[pos] = 0;\n            __syncthreads();\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        int* cidx = blk_idx;\n        double* cmd = blk_md;\n        if (n <= QT_SHARED_CAP) {\n            for (int i = tid; i < n; i += QT_BLOCK) {\n                s_idx[i] = blk_idx[i];\n                s_md[i] = blk_md[i];\n            }\n            cidx = s_idx;\n            cmd = s_md;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Phase 2: greedy growth. cmd[i] holds the max distance from candidate\n        // i to all current members (= cluster diameter if i were added).\n        int card = 1;\n        Point np = sp;      // newest member\n        while (true) {\n            double bv = INFINITY;\n            int bi = INT_MAX;\n            int bs = -1;\n            for (int i = tid; i < n; i += QT_BLOCK) {\n                double v = cmd[i];\n                if (v < thr) {\n                    const int c = cidx[i];\n                    const double d = distance(pts[c], np);\n                    v = fmax(v, d);\n                    cmd[i] = v;\n                    if (v < thr && (v < bv || (v == bv && c < bi))) {\n                        bv = v; bi = c; bs = i;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            blockMin(bv, bi, bs, s_rv, s_ri, s_rs);\n            if (!(bv < thr)) break;\n            card++;\n            if (tid == 0) cmd[bs] = INFINITY;\n            np = pts[bi];\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            out_card[pos] = card;\n            atomicMax(best_hint, card);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Re-grow the candidate cluster of one seed on the host (OpenMP). Uses the\n// same incremental max-distance scheme as the GPU kernel, so the result is\n// identical to the kernel's cardinality and to the sequential algorithm.\nstatic void growClusterHost(const int seed,\n                            const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,\n                            const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                            const double threshold,\n                            std::vector<int>& members) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n    // Candidate compaction (ascending index order).\n    std::vector<int> cidx;\n    std::vector<double> cmd;\n    cidx.reserve(1024);\n    cmd.reserve(1024);\n    for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n        if (c == seed || clustered[c]) continue;\n        const double d = distance(points[c], sp);\n        if (d < threshold) {\n            cidx.push_back(c);\n            cmd.push_back(d);\n        }\n    }\n    const int n = static_cast<int>(cidx.size());\n\n    members.clear();\n    members.push_back(seed);\n    if (n == 0) return;\n\n    const int nthreads = std::max(1, std::min(omp_get_max_threads(), (n + 255) / 256));\n    std::vector<double> t_v(nthreads);\n    std::vector<int> t_i(nthreads), t_s(nthreads);\n    int newest = seed;\n    bool done = false;\n\n#pragma omp parallel num_threads(nthreads)\n    {\n        const int t = omp_get_thread_num();\n        const int chunk = (n + nthreads - 1) / nthreads;\n        const int lo = t * chunk;\n        const int hi = std::min(n, lo + chunk);\n        while (true) {\n            const Point np = points[newest];\n            double bv = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();\n            int bi = std::numeric_limits<int>::max();\n            int bs = -1;\n            for (int i = lo; i < hi; ++i) {\n                double v = cmd[i];\n                if (v < threshold) {\n                    const int c = cidx[i];\n                    const double d = distance(points[c], np);\n                    v = std::max(v, d);\n                    cmd[i] = v;\n                    if (v < threshold && (v < bv || (v == bv && c < bi))) {\n                        bv = v; bi = c; bs = i;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            t_v[t] = bv; t_i[t] = bi; t_s[t] = bs;\n#pragma omp barrier\n#pragma omp single\n            {\n                double gv = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();\n                int gi = std::numeric_limits<int>::max();\n                int gs = -1;\n                for (int k = 0; k < nthreads; ++k) {\n                    if (t_v[k] < gv || (t_v[k] == gv && t_i[k] < gi)) {\n                        gv = t_v[k]; gi = t_i[k]; gs = t_s[k];\n                    }\n                }\n                if (gv < threshold) {\n                    members.push_back(gi);\n                    cmd[gs] = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();\n                    newest = gi;\n                } else {\n                    done = true;\n                }\n            } // implicit barrier\n            if (done) break;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstruct GpuContext {\n    int device = 0;\n    int num_sms = 1;\n    int grid = 1;\n    Point* d_pts = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_bounds = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_card = nullptr;\n    int* d_members = nullptr;\n    int* d_idx = nullptr;\n    double* d_md = nullptr;\n    int* d_counters = nullptr;   // [0] work counter, [1] best hint\n    int scratch_stride = 0;\n};\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  GpuContext& gpu, const int rank, const int nranks) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> bounds(N);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Exact cardinality upper bounds for every point.\n    initBoundsKernel<<<(N + 255) / 256, 256>>>(gpu.d_pts, N, threshold, gpu.d_bounds);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(bounds.data(), gpu.d_bounds, N * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    std::vector<int> sorted;      // unclustered points, bound desc, index asc\n    std::vector<int> my_seeds;    // this rank's share of `sorted`\n    std::vector<int> my_card;\n    std::vector<int> hist;\n    std::vector<int> best_members;\n    int remaining = N;\n\n    while (remaining > 0) {\n        // Counting sort of unclustered points by bound (descending),\n        // ascending index within equal bounds (deterministic).\n        int max_bound = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)\n            if (!clustered[i] && bounds[i] > max_bound) max_bound = bounds[i];\n\n        // Every remaining point is isolated: in the sequential algorithm each\n        // of them becomes a singleton cluster in ascending index order.\n        if (max_bound <= 1) {\n            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n                if (clustered[i]) continue;\n                Cluster c;\n                c.seed_point = i;\n                c.members.push_back(i);\n                clusters.push_back(c);\n                clustered[i] = 1;\n            }\n            remaining = 0;\n            break;\n        }\n\n        hist.assign(max_bound + 2, 0);\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)\n            if (!clustered[i]) hist[max_bound - bounds[i] + 1]++;\n        for (int b = 1; b <= max_bound + 1; ++b) hist[b] += hist[b - 1];\n        sorted.resize(remaining);\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)\n            if (!clustered[i]) sorted[hist[max_bound - bounds[i]]++] = i;\n\n        // Round-robin distribution of sorted seeds across ranks.\n        my_seeds.clear();\n        for (int p = rank; p < remaining; p += nranks) my_seeds.push_back(sorted[p]);\n        const int nmy = static_cast<int>(my_seeds.size());\n\n        long long local_best = -1;\n        if (nmy > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(gpu.d_seeds, my_seeds.data(), nmy * sizeof(int),\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(gpu.d_counters, 0, 2 * sizeof(int)));\n            const int grid = std::min(gpu.grid, nmy);\n            seedCardinalityKernel<<<grid, QT_BLOCK>>>(\n                gpu.d_pts, N, gpu.d_clustered, gpu.d_seeds, nmy, gpu.d_bounds, threshold,\n                gpu.d_idx, gpu.d_md, gpu.scratch_stride, gpu.d_card,\n                gpu.d_counters, gpu.d_counters + 1);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            my_card.resize(nmy);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(my_card.data(), gpu.d_card, nmy * sizeof(int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n            int bc = -1, bs = -1;\n            for (int i = 0; i < nmy; ++i) {\n                const int c = my_card[i];\n                if (c > bc || (c == bc && my_seeds[i] < bs)) { bc = c; bs = my_seeds[i]; }\n            }\n            if (bc > 0) local_best = static_cast<long long>(bc) * (N + 1) + (N - bs);\n        }\n\n        // Global winner: max cardinality, lowest seed index on ties.\n        long long global_best = -1;\n        MPI_Allreduce(&local_best, &global_best, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        const int best_card = static_cast<int>(global_best / (N + 1));\n        const int best_seed = N - static_cast<int>(global_best % (N + 1));\n\n        // Re-grow the winning cluster on the host (identical arithmetic).\n        growClusterHost(best_seed, clustered, points, threshold, best_members);\n        if (static_cast<int>(best_members.size()) != best_card) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"Internal error: host/device cardinality mismatch (%zu vs %d)\\n\",\n                    best_members.size(), best_card);\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2);\n        }\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        cluster.members = best_members;\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        for (int m : best_members) clustered[m] = 1;\n        remaining -= static_cast<int>(best_members.size());\n\n        // Update device state: clustered flags and exact bounds.\n        const int m = static_cast<int>(best_members.size());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(gpu.d_members, best_members.data(), m * sizeof(int),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        updateBoundsKernel<<<(N + 255) / 256, 256>>>(gpu.d_pts, N, gpu.d_clustered,\n                                                     gpu.d_members, m, threshold, gpu.d_bounds);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(gpu.d_clustered, clustered.data(), N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(bounds.data(), gpu.d_bounds, N * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Diameters of all clusters (OpenMP over clusters, dynamic for imbalance)\n    std::vector<double> diameters(clusters.size(), 0.0);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n#pragma omp parallel for reduction(+ : clustered_count)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nstatic void setupGpu(GpuContext& gpu, const std::vector<Point>& points, const int max_bound) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(gpu.device));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&gpu.num_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, gpu.device));\n    int blocks_per_sm = 1;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(\n        &blocks_per_sm, seedCardinalityKernel, QT_BLOCK, 0));\n    gpu.grid = std::max(1, gpu.num_sms * std::max(1, blocks_per_sm));\n\n    // Per-block candidate scratch: no seed can have more candidates than the\n    // largest neighbourhood (max_bound - 1).\n    gpu.scratch_stride = std::max(32, ((max_bound + 31) / 32) * 32);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.d_pts, N * sizeof(Point)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.d_clustered, N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.d_bounds, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.d_seeds, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.d_card, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.d_members, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.d_idx, static_cast<size_t>(gpu.grid) * gpu.scratch_stride * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.d_md, static_cast<size_t>(gpu.grid) * gpu.scratch_stride * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&gpu.d_counters, 2 * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.d_pts, points.data(), N * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(gpu.d_clustered, 0, N));\n}\n\nstatic void teardownGpu(GpuContext& gpu) {\n    cudaFree(gpu.d_pts);\n    cudaFree(gpu.d_clustered);\n    cudaFree(gpu.d_bounds);\n    cudaFree(gpu.d_seeds);\n    cudaFree(gpu.d_card);\n    cudaFree(gpu.d_members);\n    cudaFree(gpu.d_idx);\n    cudaFree(gpu.d_md);\n    cudaFree(gpu.d_counters);\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (rank == 0)\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // One GPU per rank, selected by the rank's position on its node.\n    GpuContext gpu;\n    {\n        MPI_Comm node_comm;\n        MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &node_comm);\n        int node_rank = 0;\n        MPI_Comm_rank(node_comm, &node_rank);\n        MPI_Comm_free(&node_comm);\n        int ndev = 0;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&ndev));\n        if (ndev <= 0) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n        gpu.device = node_rank % ndev;\n    }\n\n    // Generate synthetic data (deterministic, identical on every rank)\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n\n    // Upper bound on neighbourhood size for scratch sizing: a disc of radius\n    // `threshold` can hold at most all N points, so size by N but never more\n    // than needed for the problem.\n    setupGpu(gpu, points, num_points);\n\n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, gpu, rank, nranks);\n\n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n\n    teardownGpu(gpu);\n\n    if (rank != 0) {\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n    printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n\n    // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n    int total_clustered = 0;\n    int max_cluster_size = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n        const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n        total_clustered += size;\n        max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n    }\n\n    const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 :\n        static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n\n The winner of each iteration is selected with one `MPI_Allreduce`, and its member list is broadcast by the owning rank.\n- **CUDA** does the heavy work: one thread block grows one candidate cluster, pulling seeds dynamically from a work list sorted by an exact upper bound.
